title: Prove threshold-preserving dominance for class-C campaigns
body:
The class-C campaign needs a sound implication from a larger flat configuration to a smaller listed cover, at the **same target threshold**. This package proves that implication and supplies exact, threshold-aware row certificates.

For nested flats, the covered labels grow, the residual label rank cannot increase, and `H(smaller) ⊆ H(larger)`. A uniform span pass therefore transfers without weakening its threshold. Conditional on the inherited listed-cover premise:

- `6554@T7` and `5555@T8` suffice for the 16 table-coverable HARD rows; row 37 remains unresolved.
- `6554@T6` and `5555@T8` suffice for all 64 table-coverable rows.
- `T8` for both does **not** imply the required result for HARD rows 7, 8 and 13.

The audit also found that the initial PR #3315 head `c4fe4244b52bb9111b9117aba066229316fc58ab`'s named literal triple covers only 55 of those 64 rows, missing `4,5,6,17,20,28,33,66,69`. The literal minimum is four for all rows and three for the HARD subset; dimension closure gives two. All five original #2954 coverage totals are recovered, retaining their original credit.

After [my advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2954#discussioncomment-19006125), the predecessor author adopted dimension closure at `240e7f68c6be0cd7193abdd1d686ec5b90ab5355`, [credited the observation and explicitly left the same-target lemma open](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2954#discussioncomment-19006436). This PR supplies that missing implication and its bounded replay; it does not characterize the amended checker as still using literal incidence.

## Evidence

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/class-c-dominance-campaign
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/class-c-dominance-campaign
```

Both pass at `c5ae026dd7e482aabcb4c2f97e8a72bbcb762297`. The primary sorted-dimension implementation and a separately written injective-role matcher agree on all 169 ordered configuration comparisons and the complete incidence object. Both independently enumerate minimum covers. Four rejecting certificate mutants cover threshold weakening, false dominance, invented cover and budget overflow. Normal and optimized direct replay pass.

All ten package files match the committed bytes. The official export integrity check and both optimized scripts also pass from the final committed, read-only, Git-free export. Environment: CPython 3.12 on macOS, standard library only, each direct check under one second. Internal AI review found no scoped blocker; no independent human or proof-kernel review is claimed. Hosted CI is separate.

Started at canonical main `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a` and rebased onto refreshed main `b0186c6b75280913969f101c169fe3fb07afd137`; priority revision 6 and the selected record are unchanged. Final overlap refresh covered 248 open PRs and 2,170 Discussion records with complete pagination and no warnings. Arbitrary diffs and unpublished work are outside coverage.

## Scope and credit

No geometric span pass, new row exclusion, RRC validation, complete configuration-list reconstruction, CPU-hour saving, supplier, new kappa or selected-frontier change. The original cover assertions, `g` bounds and Lemma B remain inherited. No large census, selected cold replay, Lean or Docker was run. Only one new opt-in research package changes.

Credit DreamingOfClouds' pinned help package `1b25759bff5486293a9083ebbe0097b5f6642e08`, original totals and retained #2816/#2826/#2862 lineage; muatfannajm-dot / #3315's table audit and handoff; Tekalign / #2975/#3000's separate accelerations. Krzysztof Wojt, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance including Luna supporting checks. Apache-2.0. Exact sources, proof, limitations and Open next questions are in the package.
